text_block_list.text:
On the way back from my outing with
Gold City,
we pass by a bookstore in the
shopping district.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh—it's that magazine... So they've even
got it on
display here, huh.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
Is that the one where you guys recommended
outfits to readers?

text_block_list.text:
Yup, the one you helped me with at the
mall.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
My recommendations were a hit at the
studio too,
so thanks again.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, can I look around a
bit?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
This one, this one... Oh, and this one
too.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
The stack of books Голд Сити chooses
gets taller
and taller.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I thought she'd only be picking out
magazines,
but there are denser
paperbacks in the mix too.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: (Is she going to read all of them?)

text_block_list.text: Oh hey, if it isn't City!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: Whoa, you're buy'n a lotta books!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, I do read quite a bit. You
know, on
the bus, during downtime
between shoots...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Wow, I see! And you even read
tricky-look'n
books like these?
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
YЭпизод These are recommendations from
my
coworkers.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Gives you something to talk about,
y'know? I try
to read all of them.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
That's so cool! You must be really good
at work!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Sure... Anyway, why are you buying so
many
books on training?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити points at a basket full of
books Yukino
Bijin appears to have
selected.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, heh... I couldn't decide which
one to buy,
so I kept putt'n more in the
basket.
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text: Maybe it's none of my business, but...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Instead of buying every book under the
sun, try
really digging into this one here.
My trainer's read
it too, you know.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: You even read the stuff I read?

text_block_list.text:
I mean, training's easier when we're on
the same
wavelength, isn't it?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Plus, well... you actually have decent
sense. I
found it useful.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити never cuts corners, no matter
how busy
she is.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Recommend her a book on training.

text_block_list.text:
I recommend a book that would pair well
with
Gold City's suggestion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Golly... This one's a lot more compact'n
the other
books I found...
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm sure you've got nothing to
worry about.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Should be able to trust a trainer's picks
when it
comes to books about training,
right?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
To learn more about modeling, I decide
to buy an
autobiography of a famous
model.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Why that book? Modeling isn't your
thing, is it?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Well, shouldn't we be on the same wavelength?

text_block_list.text:
I tell her that I want to do my best to
match her
effort and enthusiasm.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Th-that's amaz'n! It's like I'm watch'n a
teen
drama!
text_block_list.name: Юкино Бидзин

text_block_list.text:
What the—what do you mean? This is
nothing like
that.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, Trainer, I... I appreciate the
thought.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I can't help but swell with pride a little
after Gold
City's comment. I decide to
buy them each a copy
of the book I
recommended.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
